name: FormGroup

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the FormGroup should be disabled

props.name: legendId
props.description: Provide id for the fieldset <legend> which corresponds to the fieldset `aria-labelledby`

props.name: legendText
props.description: Provide the text to be rendered inside of the fieldset <legend>

props.name: message
props.description: Specify whether the message should be displayed in the <FormGroup>

props.name: messageText
props.description: Provide the text for the message in the <FormGroup>

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon FormGroup rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
